newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's SEC slaps fine on Filinvest.
newsitem.headline: Manila's SEC slaps fine on Filinvest.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has fined Filinvest Land Inc for its late disclosure of a cease-and-desist order on a major land development project.

Filinvest Land told the stock exchange on Friday the SEC slapped the company a 50,000 peso fine plus 500 pesos for every day of delay for not immediately disclosing the Department of Environment and Natural Resources' (DENR) order against its Sky City project.
"We are currently studying the feasiblity of filing a motion for reconsideration of the aforesaid penalty," Filinvest corporate secretary Dante Ramos said.

The DENR refused to grant an environmental clearance certificate (ECC) to the Sky City project and imposed a 50,000-peso penalty on the firm for allegedly violating the environmental impact assessment (EIA) law.
The Sky City project is a 667-hectare complex with houses, condominiums, resort hotels, commercial centres, recreational facilities and a golf course in San Mateo, Rizal, just east of Manila.
Filinvest earlier said it is appealing the DENR decision with President Fidel Ramos.
